WashingAgentDrainMalfunction.description: Indicates whether there is an error with the washing agent drain. True in case of error. Examples: clogging, burst pipe, defective valve.

WashingAgentDrainOpen.description: Indicates that the washing agent drain valve is open.

WashingAgentInflowMalfunction.description: Indicates whether there is an error with the washing agent inflow. True in case of error. Examples: clogging, burst pipe, defective valve.

WashingAgentInflowOpen.description: Indicates that the washing agent inflow valve is open.
